description: This file defines the Event model class within the Opencart admin setting namespace. The class provides methods for managing event records in the database, including adding, deleting, updating, and retrieving events. It interacts with the database through queries to perform CRUD operations on the 'event' table.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Model class for managing Opencart system events, supporting CRUD operations for event data.

methods.name: addEvent
methods.description: Inserts a new event record into the database with provided data and returns its ID.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event from the database based on its primary key (event_id).

methods.name: deleteEventByCode
methods.description: Deletes an event from the database based on its unique code.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an event identified by event_id.

methods.name: editStatusByCode
methods.description: Updates the status of an event identified by its code.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Retrieves an event record by its primary key (event_id).

methods.name: getEventByCode
methods.description: Retrieves an event record by its code.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Fetches a list of events with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalEvents
methods.description: Returns the total count of event records with optional filtering.
